title: Full-frame menu and next/later strip
slide_intent: Show adjacent choices without losing the current focus so viewers understand a schedule as a sequence.
strategic_value: The nudge between gradient panels can make Channel 4’s programme navigation feel like movement through one content universe.
demonstration: The film compares a full-frame 9pm/10pm menu, footage with a side panel, next/later cards and a shallow scheduling strip beneath end credits.
practical_value: Choose a menu scale appropriate to how much of the current programme must remain visible.

content_islands.name: Full-frame choices
content_islands.spec: Move horizontally between large time-and-title panels.

content_islands.name: Reduced layouts
content_islands.spec: Apply the same neighboring-panel idea beside footage and beneath credits.

reference_purposes.Application: The film compares scheduling treatments at full-frame, side-panel and credit-strip scales.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram describes nudging into adjoining worlds as a functional tool for showing what is next.
